title: A Phase II Study of Dasatinib in the Treatment of Relapsed or Plateau Phase Multiple Myeloma

sections.abstract:
To evaluate the response rate (Complete Response \[CR\] and Partial Response \[PR\]) to dasatinib in patients with relapsed, refractory or plateau phase multiple myeloma whose serum paraprotein levels are \>0.5g/dL or urine paraprotein levels are \>1.0g/24 hours.

Posted outcomes: Response Rate [Complete Response (CR) and Partial Response (PR)]. timeframe=Completion of treatment (median duration of therapy was 51 days). Dasatinib 70 mg BID=0; Dasatinib 100 mg BID=0
